words.sense: Travelling from place to place for work or practical duties rather than establishing a travelling household.
misconceptions: Assuming everyone who travels frequently has a nomadic way of life.

words.sense: Living a way of life organized around moving from one place to another rather than a fixed home.
words.connotation: Rootless or mobile in lifestyle; not necessarily negative.
misconceptions: Assuming working remotely automatically makes mobile living occupational travel.

semantic_axes.description: Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives.

edges.boundary_rule: Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives.
clues_a: travels on a scheduled job circuit
keeps travel tied to occupational duties
clues_b: has no fixed residence by choice or circumstance
organizes everyday living around successive locations
irrelevant_clues: whether the traveller owns a laptop
how comfortable the temporary accommodation is

misconceptions.M1: Assuming everyone who travels frequently has a nomadic way of life.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming working remotely automatically makes mobile living occupational travel.
misconceptions.M3: Assuming the distance or number of stops, not the purpose of movement, decides the word.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Zara’s pattern of travel?

beats.text: Zara drives between villages each weekday to treat farm animals, carrying her medicine bag in the car.
beats.decisive_clue: visits are arranged around animal appointments
beats.reason: Visits are arranged around animal appointments. Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives.

beats.text: Each evening, she returns to the same apartment, where she keeps her belongings.
beats.decisive_clue: visits are arranged around animal appointments
beats.reason: The new detail does not overturn the original clue: visits are arranged around animal appointments. Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives.

chains.feedback_short: Animal appointments explain the trips; returning home confirms this is travel for work.
chains.feedback_deep: Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives. Her stable home does not move with the visits.
chains.contrast_rule: Itinerant describes movement for work or duties; nomadic describes movement as the pattern of where someone lives.
